AVI/animateAVI.bas: Its QANIMATE's area: RC.EXE's white, RapidR's the form's colour.
AVI/VideoPlayer.bas: The frame shown at the capture differs (the video plays).
CGI/test_256Byte.bas: RapidQ's CGI PRINT sends 255 characters of a longer string, then NULs (the program shows that bug); RapidR sends the whole string.
CGI/cgi_test.rqb: It stores a numeric method's result (whether a form field was found) in the STRING it passed BYREF for the field's value: RapidQ then keeps that argument's text ("" here), RapidR stores "0" (a judgment call: docs/rapidq-ground-truth.md).
Database/mdb/1-CreateDB.bas: Its message box: RC.EXE's (Delphi's) sizes itself to Windows 11's message font, Segoe UI 9 (90 high); RapidR's classic look uses MS Sans Serif 8 (78).
Database/mdb/7-FormRecord.bas: RC.EXE's run had no Test.mdb (only RapidR's runs made it, with 1-CreateDB): RC.EXE says so, RapidR shows the form.
sockets/getMyIp.bas: QSOCKET's GetHostIP / GetHostName read without parentheses gave "" (fixed: they call the method); message box font, as Database/mdb/1-CreateDB.
sockets/Ip_Message.bas: GetHostIP / GetHostName without parentheses read "" (fixed); RC.EXE's capture leaves out its borderless form.
sockets/FD_File_Receiver.bas: WSAAsyncSelect on QSOCKET's socket and the form's WndProc: RapidR's sockets are its own, and window messages don't reach a WndProc (docs/windows-dll-calls.md §3).
direct3d/smooth_move.bas: ClientWidth / ClientHeight, then BorderStyle = bsDialog: RC.EXE keeps the window's outer size, so on Windows 11 its inside grows by the frames' difference (10); RapidR keeps the inside the program set.
Mouse/select2.bas.bas: A form narrower than Windows' smallest window: Windows widens RC.EXE's; RapidR's keeps the program's Width.
games/puzzle/puzzle.bas: ClientWidth / ClientHeight set before its main menu: RapidR's menu is inside the window (28) and leaves less room, so scroll bars show; RC.EXE's inside is 207 × 223 on Windows 11.
games/Sokoban/SokobanBuilder.bas: Form frame: RC.EXE's inside is smaller on Windows 11.
games/shisen/shisen.bas: Random tiles; RapidR's in-window menu moves the board down.
System/showhide.bas: Form frame: RC.EXE's smaller inside cuts its oval buttons.
graphics/Choosecolor.bas: A form 50 high: what fits inside differs with the frame (RapidR shows the form's scroll bar).
System/SPYINFO3A.bas: Another window's coordinates from Windows: RapidR is DPI-aware (the VM's screen at 200%: 3212 × 2008), RC.EXE gets scaled ones (1606 × 1004).
keyboard/hotkeys/hotkeys.bas: RegisterHotKey with the form's Handle before it shows (RapidR's form has no window yet), and WM_HOTKEY through a WndProc: the program says the key is taken (docs/windows-dll-calls.md §3).
graphics/GDI_p.bas: GdiplusStartup is given VARPTR of a TYPE through a LONG: under RapidQ VARPTR of a TYPE isn't an address (RC.EXE: 1 here, GDI+'s version by accident); RapidR's is: error 17 (docs/windows-dll-calls.md).
forms/deskform/deskform.bas: PaintDesktop on the form's DC: RapidR repaints its form over it (docs/windows-dll-calls.md §3).
forms/Qeform.bas: SetWindowRgn: RapidR's window stays a rectangle (docs/windows-dll-calls.md §3).
forms/wndproc/winex.bas: Controls made with CreateWindowEx on the form's window: RapidR draws its form over them.
forms/purewindows/wnd.bas: A window of its own (RegisterClass, CreateWindowEx, a CODEPTR window procedure, its own message loop): callbacks aren't supported.
FolderTree/QFolderTree.rqb: No window before the capture. Its folder list asks DIR$ and QFILELISTBOX for names without an extension (a pattern ending in a dot): RapidR read the dot literally, and listed Windows' hidden and system folders (fixed).
files/dirtree/dirtree.bas: RapidR's QDIRTREE gave every closed folder a + (fixed: only folders with folders in them, as RC.EXE's).
Gauge/CoolGauge.bas: RC.EXE's capture of its canvas is black; RapidR draws the bars.
graphics/credits/credits.bas: Scrolling text: the moment of the capture.
graphics/Gamma.bas: Gamma ramp: the capture's moment and colours.
music/GMSynth.rqb: It reads its settings from COMMAND$(0) with ".exe" replaced by ".gms": run by the interpreter COMMAND$(0) is the .rqb, so it starts empty (native: as RC.EXE).
music/GMDrum1.1 (Davids Improvements).rq: Timing and the capture's moment (a drum machine).
music/StutterBox.rqb: A FOR with no start value: RC.EXE counts from 0 (fixed).
OpenGL/GL_test1.bas: It closes its form in OnShow when back.bmp is missing; under ShowModal RC.EXE's form stays (VCL resets ModalResult after OnShow): fixed.
OpenGL/GL_test2.bas: OpenGL through opengl32: RapidR's form is drawn over the GL surface (and its message box).
richedit/syntax/syntax.bas: RRichEdit's formatting (SelAttributes) isn't drawn yet: the code shows without its colours.
forms/Window Sizer.BAS: A second ELSE in one IF: RC.EXE compiles it and never runs what follows (fixed).
direct3d/RQ_3DTerrain/Terrain16.bas: An IF left open at END SUB, closed by an extra END IF in the next SUB: RC.EXE keeps one stack per kind of block across SUBs; RapidR stops at the END IF.
mysql/rqlibsql/mySQL_API.bas: An END IF inside a FOR closing an IF opened before it: RC.EXE accepts the misnesting; RapidR stops at the END IF.
games/asteroids.bas: A typo calls an undefined name (shoy for shot): RC.EXE compiles a call of an unknown name as 0; RapidR stops with "Unknown SUB or FUNCTION".
System/CreateShellLink.bas: STKIT432.DLL (Visual Basic 4's setup kit) isn't on Windows 11.
dll/simple/DLL.BAS: Its PASCAL.DLL is 32-bit; RapidR programs are 64-bit.
asm/TestRqUtilsDll.Bas: Its RqUtils.dll is 32-bit; RapidR programs are 64-bit.
thread/Pipe.BAS: CreateThread with a CODEPTR: callbacks aren't supported.
forms/QTabControl/QTabVertical.bas: SendMessage to a control's Handle with a 32-bit pointer in a LONG (TCITEM): RapidR's controls have no window, and the pointer doesn't fit.
AVI/testAVItoBMP.bas: AVIFile's interface pointers kept in LONGs: 64-bit pointers don't fit.
Database/DatabaseViewer/DatabaseViewer.r: ODBC handles kept in LONGs: 64-bit handles don't fit.
sound/midi/playmidi.bas: mciExecute shows Windows' own error box (no passport.mid on Windows 11) in both; RapidR's process is DPI-aware, so the box is drawn at the screen's scale.
QTabControl/QTabContol_add_del.bas: Native: an array of components DIMmed in a SUB isn't found by the generated Rust (`tab`); interpreted as RC.EXE.
QDerulantPanel/QDerulantPanel_test.rqw: Native: the build stops as it starts (0xC000007B, a bad image); interpreted as RC.EXE.
